name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Strategic Partnerships & Channel Management | B2B SaaS Partner Growth, Enablement & HubSpot
summary: Partnerships and business development professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments. At Birdeye, onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) and retained all but one, building the training and automated enablement sequences that got partners selling. Backed by a decade of full-cycle SaaS sales (top three on an 8-15 rep team at Accelo, selling CRM and integration-heavy software) and hands-on HubSpot pipeline discipline, so partner activity turns into tracked, forecastable revenue.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B service businesses, running discovery and onboarding and expanding retainer scope with complementary services.
Architect CRM systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel (segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, data hygiene) and build dashboards tracking lead generation, pipeline velocity, and ROI.
Grew a free audit offer through LinkedIn into 180+ enrolled businesses and 2 paying clients, running the outreach and follow-up automation personally.
Write and publish thought leadership, newsletters, and guides on CRM and operational growth for B2B audiences.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts across marketing and technology channels in HubSpot, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built performance reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and delivered recommendations and QBRs to client leadership.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Sold and onboarded partners on Birdeye's proprietary listings-syndication solution, the backbone of the channel offer, so every partner's end customers launched on a properly configured setup.
Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, driving adoption of marketing automation and reputation management products.
Built scalable partner communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own clients.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn; fed structured partner feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (several above $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings, and led the sales team.
Pursued a major northeastern U.S. banking prospect through to finalist stage, managing a complex multi-stakeholder evaluation.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8) and developed sales training for tenured account executives in a new vertical that grew from proof of concept to profitable.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps over a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled, closing deals of $20K+.
Sold and scoped CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, guiding onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations with C-suite stakeholders.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Prospected and qualified leads in HubSpot, booking a steady flow of sales-ready meetings for regional sales representatives.
